To view the full publication, “The Infrastructure Bottleneck Investors Should Watch as AI Demand Accelerates,” please visit: https://ibn.fm/SRaJI

Computing capacity is what the AI industry is sprinting to add. Just as fast, though, a different limit is taking shape: power supply. By 2030, the International Energy Agency expects global electricity demand from data centers to keep rising steeply. Goldman Sachs estimates the compound annual growth rate for U.S. data-center power demand at around 15% between 2023 and 2030, a pace that could leave data centers responsible for roughly 8% of all U.S. electricity consumption by the end of that period. As AI’s hunger for compute outpaces what the grid can supply, the gap between the two is changing both the location and the design of AI infrastructure projects.

is chasing exactly that opening through its power-backed compute campuses, among them Atlas One, its project in south Texas. The company has now put that strategy into action, announcing its first hosting agreement at Atlas One with Power Champion Investment Limited. The deal starts at 10 megawatts of capacity and carries rights to expand up to 50 megawatts.

AZIO AI Holdings is a technology infrastructure company focused on developing, owning, and operating artificial intelligence data centers, enterprise GPU compute infrastructure, digital power solutions and digital asset mining operations.

The company operates an integrated AI infrastructure business encompassing AI data center development, the sale and distribution of enterprise GPU systems and server infrastructure, high-performance computing solutions, power hosting, and strategic technology investments, serving enterprise and institutional customers across domestic and international markets.

Through this diversified AI infrastructure strategy, the company is positioned to capitalize on the rapidly expanding global demand for AI infrastructure, compute capacity, digital power and next-generation AI technologies.
The latest news and updates relating to AZIO are available in the company’s newsroom at https://ibn.fm/AZIO
